definition: Separated mentally or conceptually from something else.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: “For gracious sake say something else besides ‘indeed,’ or you’ll fidget me to death,” said Miss Pross: whose character (dissociated from stature) was shortness.
example_sentence: After the long shift, she felt strangely dissociated from everything.
